<!-- link1 "Press Release" -->
<DIV align="left"><A NAME="000"></A></DIV>

<DIV align="center" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><IMG src="c11107c1110701.gif" alt="(VALE LOGO)">
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>Vale makes payment to holders of mandatorily convertible notes</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">Rio de Janeiro, January&nbsp;14, 2011 &#151; Vale S.A. (Vale) will pay additional interest to the holders of
the mandatorily convertible notes due June&nbsp;15, 2012 (the series VALE-2012 and VALE.P- 2012) issued
by its wholly-owned subsidiary, Vale Capital II.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">The additional interest paid per series VALE-2012 notes and per series VALE.P-2012 notes will be
equal to an amount in U.S. dollars equivalent to R$ 0.7776700 and R$ 0.8994610, respectively,
converted at the Brazilian real/US dollar exchange rate prevailing on January&nbsp;31, 2011.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">The notes will begin trading &#147;ex-dividend&#148; on the New York Stock Exchange on January&nbsp;14, 2011.
Investors holding notes through an account with The Depository Trust Company (DTC)&nbsp;will be paid in
accordance with the procedures of DTC and the investor&#146;s custodian.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">Under the indentures governing the notes, additional interest due to each noteholder is an amount
in U.S. dollars equal to any cash distribution net of any applicable withholding tax and fees paid
by the Depositary of our ADSs &#151; each representing one common/preferred Vale share, VALE/VALE.P &#151;
to the holder of one ADS, multiplied by the number of ADSs that would be received by the noteholder
upon conversion of the notes at the conversion rate specified in the applicable indenture.
Therefore, the approval by our Board of Directors of a dividend distribution to shareholders, as
announced today, triggered the payment of additional interest to noteholders.
</DIV>

<DIV align="right" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>For further information, please contact:</B><BR>
&#043;55-21-3814-4540<BR>
Roberto Castello Branco: roberto.castello.branco@vale.com<BR>
Viktor Moszkowicz: viktor.moszkowicz@vale.com<BR>
Carla Albano Miller: carla.albano@vale.com<BR>
Andrea Gutman: andrea.gutman@vale.com<BR>
Fernando Frey: fernando.frey@vale.com<BR>
Marcio Loures Penna: marcio.penna@vale.com<BR>
Samantha Pons: samantha.pons@vale.com<BR>
Thomaz Freire: thomaz.freire@vale.com
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">This press release may include declarations about Vale&#146;s expectations regarding future events or
results. All declarations based upon future expectations, rather than historical facts, are subject
to various risks and uncertainties. Vale cannot guarantee that such declarations will prove to be
correct. These risks and uncertainties include factors related to the following: (a)&nbsp;the countries
where Vale operates, mainly Brazil and Canada; (b)&nbsp;the global economy; (c)&nbsp;capital markets; (d)&nbsp;the
mining and metals businesses and their dependence upon global industrial production, which is
cyclical by nature; and (e)&nbsp;the high degree of global competition in the markets in which Vale
operates. To obtain further information on factors that may give rise to results different from
those forecast by Vale, please consult the reports filed with the Brazilian Comiss&#227;o de Valores
Mobili&#225;rios (CVM), the French Autorit&#233; des March&#233;s Financiers (AMF), and with the U.S. Securities
and Exchange Commission (SEC), including Vale&#146;s most recent Annual Report on Form&nbsp;20F and its
reports on Form&nbsp;6K.
</DIV>
